req.title: Player payload includes squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall include the squadNumber field on every response body under /players/.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-032 requires that every response body under /players/ includes the squadNumber field. The primary endpoint under test is GET /players/{id}. We need: (1) a positive EP test confirming squadNumber is present and has the correct exact integer value for a known player; (2) a negative NEG test confirming a non-existent UUID returns 404 and no player body; (3) a BVA boundary test using the lowest squad number (1) and highest squad number (26) to confirm squadNumber appears at both extremes; (4) a DT test confirming the camelCase key 'squadNumber' (not snake_case 'squad_number') is present in the JSON response, catching serialization mutations; (5) an EP test for the collection endpoint GET /players/ confirming every item in the list has squadNumber.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_exact_value
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 player rows
trace: R-PLAYER-032: squadNumber field must be present on every /players/ response
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_exact_value():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'squadNumber' in body
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert body['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'

All rows have a non-null squadNumber

expected: Response is a list of exactly 26 items
Every squadNumber is an integer between 1 and 26 inclusive
trace: R-PLAYER-032: squadNumber must appear on EVERY response body under /players/
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_get_all_players_every_item_includes_squad_number():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    players = r.json()
    assert isinstance(players, list)
    assert len(players) == 26
    squad_numbers = []
    for player in players:
        assert 'squadNumber' in player
        assert isinstance(player['squadNumber'], int)
        assert 1 <= player['squadNumber'] <= 26
        squad_numbers.append(player['squadNumber'])
    assert sorted(squad_numbers) == list(range(1, 27))
